about_the_game:
We aim to liberate every friend trapped in tedious desk jobs!

This is an idle casual game that sits at the bottom of your screen. Simply play by clicking and dragging—or do nothing at all, and the game will keep running on its own. In the game, you’ll recruit adorable animals to work at your startup company. Your job? Be the boss and make sure they don’t slack off! Profits generated by their work or spending can be used to renovate or expand your cozy office—or splurge on cyber-themed indulgences. After all, you’re the boss!

Character Design

The game features a wide variety of adorable animals (only a few designs are shown here). Each has unique personalities, career backgrounds, and quirks—these differences are part of the fun! What will they do once they join your company?

Office Customization

The game offers diverse range of themed scenes and furniture to match. Unleash your creativity and design a one-of-a-kind office!

You can even change the exterior buildings to place your office in any city you like—Tokyo skyscrapers, Parisian alleys, or cyberpunk metropolises!

Furniture & Props

Every piece of furniture you buy for the office unlocks new interactions for your animal employees. The more variety you add, the richer their behaviors become! Plus, you can click on these cute furniture items with your mouse to interact with them yourself!

The translation preserves the playful and motivational tone while adapting idioms like "摸鱼" (slacking off) and (cyber-themed indulgences) for natural English readability. Let me know if you need adjustments!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows7 +
  • Processor: Inteli3-9300 or AMD Ryzen 3 2300X
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 950 or AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-12400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon R9 380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
